purpose: Verified contract for acknowledging and validating newly received property evidence.
receipt_rule: Receipt confirms arrival only; it does not establish authenticity, property identity or legal effect.
identity_rule: Document identity, property match and date match are separate validation dimensions.
source_rule: Citizen-supplied material retains its source classification until independently verified where official status matters.
scope_rule: Evidence may be sufficient for one proposition and insufficient for another.
conflict_rule: Conflicting records are preserved and reviewed rather than silently reconciled.
privacy_rule: Privacy/access status is checked before public exposure.
feedback_rule: Citizen feedback reports the actual validation state and remaining gap.
verification_boundary: The receipt/validation experience evaluates evidence; it does not create new legal conclusions.
